purpose: Small verified-reality benchmark seed for local model refinement loops with dev/holdout/promotion splits per docs/fullloop/10_PHASE_19_CURRICULUM.md.

dev.purpose: Optimizer iterates against this split. Every dev attempt may produce harness edits via the outer optimizer.

instances.why_selected: Already verified as a useful hard failure: Qwen patch applies but official Docker SWE-bench remains unresolved.
Small different-repository task with 2 FAIL_TO_PASS tests, 25 PASS_TO_PASS tests, short gold patch.

holdout.purpose: Scheduled scoring runs only. Optimizer turns are forbidden by policy on holdout-split attempts.
holdout.expansion_policy: operator-curated; add an instance only after it has been observed at least once on dev split with a known baseline_status.

promotion.purpose: Final gate before declaring a harness change is genuinely better. Run only when an experiment from the experiment-registry reaches kept status on dev + passes on holdout.
promotion.expansion_policy: operator-curated; promotion split must contain at least 30 instances before promotions are statistically meaningful.

selected_instances.why_selected: Already verified as a useful hard failure: Qwen patch applies but official Docker SWE-bench remains unresolved.
selected_instances.expected_signal: Patch may apply, but FAIL_TO_PASS includes test_requests.py::TestTimeout::test_encoded_methods, giving a concrete failure target for the next prompt.

selected_instances.why_selected: Small different-repository task with 2 FAIL_TO_PASS tests, 25 PASS_TO_PASS tests, short gold patch, and short test patch.
selected_instances.expected_signal: Tests whether the same evidence loop can guide a model outside Requests without broad corpus cost.

add_more_instances_only_when: official Docker readback is persisted into BlackBoxFix for every selected instance
failure evidence from official logs is compacted into the next model prompt
at least one task shows reward improvement across attempts
disk and Docker cache remain manually inspected after each run
promotion_rules.do_not_claim_success_until: the official SWE-bench report places the instance id in resolved_ids
champion_promotion_requires: holdout split aggregate reality_score did not regress versus prior champion
promotion split resolves every instance the prior champion resolved
no incident_packet flagged as reward_hacking_suspected for the candidate's training data
